header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
body: The petitioner is present in person and seeks urgent hearing of this petition. Urgency is allowed. This petition was filed with the following prayers:
a) That this Honourable Court may be pleased to direct Respondents No.1 to 5 to decide or pass any appropriate order on the applications forwarded by the petitioner.
b) Any other relief(s) which this Honourable Court deems fit, just and proper in favour of the petitioner.

The petitioner further submits that the application is available at Page No.27 as Annexure “E” of Court file and respondents may be directed to decide the same. Learned A.A.G, appearing in other cases waives notice of the petition and submits that it is the petitioner's right to have the application heard and decided in accordance with law.

In view of the above, this petition stands disposed of with direction to the Secretary, Education Department, Government of Sindh to decide the above application of the petitioner within a period of thirty (30) days in accordance with law.
The petition stands disposed of in the above terms.
